UPDATE "public"."folder" SET "slug" = 
                LOWER(
                  REGEXP_REPLACE(
                    TRIM("name"),
                    '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+',
                    '-',
                    'g'
                  )
                )
              , "updatedAt" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "slug" IS NULL
